question:
In the given sentence, a word is given in brackets. Select the most appropriate synonym of the word to fill in the blank.

The teacher has ________ (admitted) the student's sincere apologies.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (1)** i.e. **'**Acknowledged'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Admitted : (स्वीकार किया)** - Accepted as true or acknowledged.

 
 
• **Example: **He **admitted** his mistake and apologized for his actions.
 
 
 
• **Acknowledged : (मान्यता दी) **- Recognized, typically officially.
 
 
• **Example: **His hard work was **acknowledged **with an Employee of the Month award.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'Acknowledged' is the most appropriate synonym of the given word in the brackets.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Acknowledged'.

The complete sentence after replacing 'admitted' is *"The teacher has acknowledged __the student's sincere apologies."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Executed : (क्रियान्वित किया) **- Carried out or put into effect.

 
 
• **Example: **The team executed the plan perfectly, resulting in a successful project.
 
 
 
• **Neglected : (उपेक्षित) **- Failed to care for or look after properly.
 
 
• **Example:** He neglected to write to her.
 
 **Denied : (अस्वीकार कर दिया)** - to refuse to admit or accept something.

 
 
• **Example: **She denied having any involvement in the scheme.
